# Title Contract Checklist: Title-to-task

**Purpose**: Review completeness, clarity and consistency of the fixed library/CLI requirements before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-10-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `$speckit-checklist` for the approved fixed scope; standard depth, reviewer audience before implementation.
**Review Ownership**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality artifact. Mark `[x]` only when a reviewer determines the criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means requirements-quality approval, not implementation completion.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are both public functions and their string-input boundaries explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the exact task key set, normalized title and boolean False value specified without optional fields? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the single-title CLI output format and success exit code explicitly documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is whitespace defined explicitly to include Unicode whitespace under the approved stripping semantics? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Are non-empty Unicode acceptance and preservation of interior whitespace, case, accents and emoji specified, with Unicode normalization excluded? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK006 Are empty and whitespace-only titles explicitly distinguished from valid titles, with library ValueError and propagation documented? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002, §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK007 Are JSON key order, Unicode escaping and stderr diagnostic wording explicitly identified as unspecified? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK008 Are title validation and task shape consistent between library and CLI requirements and the public contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001–FR-005, Contract §Library, §CLI]
- [ ] CHK009 Are missing, empty, whitespace-only and extra CLI argument rules consistent about exit 2 and absence of task JSON? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §User Story 3, §SC-003]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK010 Can the success criteria be objectively assessed against the seven PRD acceptance criteria and decoded library/CLI object equality? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-002, §SC-003]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK011 Do the requirements address ordinary and already trimmed titles, Unicode boundary whitespace, empty strings and preserved interior text? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Are all documented CLI success and invalid-input scenarios covered without requiring a particular error message or JSON serialization spelling? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3, §Edge Cases]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK013 Are Python 3.13, standard-library-only scope and the exclusion of UI, storage, network, installation and extra features documented consistently? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the exact three-task dependencies, observed red/green requirement, append-only canonical evidence headings, checkbox recording and per-task commits unambiguous? [Completeness, Tasks §User Story 1, §User Story 2, §User Story 3, §Dependencies & Execution Order]

## Notes

- Every generated item remains unchecked for reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add review findings inline; references are relative to the feature documents.
